prep.title: Saturday prep for Sunday lunch
steps: Cook a double batch of the salsa verde chicken (3 lb). Shred, keep half for Saturday wraps, refrigerate the rest in its sauce.
Make a big pot of rice and refrigerate it.
Make the homemade salsa and the cucumber-tomato salad (both are better after a night in the fridge).
Sunday: reheat the chicken and rice, mash the avocados with lime and salt, and set everything out with beans, chips, Cabot cheddar and lactose-free sour cream.

recipes.name: Salsa verde honey-lime chicken
steps: Slow-cook chicken breasts in salsa verde, honey, lime juice and spices.
Shred and let it soak up the sauce for 10 minutes.
Saturday: wrap in tortillas with lettuce and tomato. Sunday: the base of the bowl bar.

recipes.name: Homemade salsa
steps: Pulse tomatoes, onion, jalapeños, garlic and cilantro in a blender or food processor.
Season with cumin, salt and lime juice. Chill overnight.

recipes.name: Cucumber, tomato & red onion salad
steps: Slice cucumbers, tomatoes and a little red onion.
Toss with olive oil, red wine vinegar, a dab of Dijon, dill and salt.

recipes.name: Instant Pot chicken meatballs & marinara
steps: Mix ground chicken with almond flour, salt, garlic and onion powder and dried herbs; roll into balls.
Pour marinara and a little water into the pot, add the meatballs and pressure-cook about 5 minutes.
Serve over pasta.

recipes.name: Ground turkey & sweet potato skillet
steps: Brown ground turkey with diced sweet potato, cumin and chipotle chili powder until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in black beans, then top with Cabot cheddar, tomato, green onion, salsa and lactose-free sour cream.

recipes.name: Coconut curry chicken
steps: Slow-cook skinless chicken thighs in coconut milk with curry powder, basil, red onion, garlic, ginger and jalapeño.
Thicken the sauce with a little cornstarch, then stir in cilantro. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Green enchilada chicken soup
steps: Slow-cook chicken with diced onion, peppers, green chiles, enchilada sauce, broth and spices.
Shred the chicken, then stir in beans, dairy-free cream cheese and lime juice.
Top with cilantro and crushed tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Skillet chicken with white beans & lemon
steps: Brown seasoned chicken thighs skin-side down until crisp, with lemon slices and shallot caramelizing alongside.
Add white beans and kale to the pan and finish in the oven until the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Chipotle-honey chicken tacos
steps: Rub chicken thighs with honey, onion and garlic powder, cumin, salt and chopped chipotles in adobo; slow-cook until tender.
Shred, stir in black beans and lime juice.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado and quick-pickled red onion.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken
steps: Marinate chicken breasts in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, thyme, Dijon and salt for a few hours.
Bake or grill, slice, and serve with rice and the cucumber-tomato salad. Friday: in wraps.
